name: Pink Elephants Trinity
review:
The third Pink Elephants game, on a 4x6 grid starting at 4,096 ways and growing to 16,384. A scatter mystery feature and sticky wilds lead into a six-level bonus where you collect sacred peanuts.

The growing ways and level-up bonus give it much more depth than the original. Very high volatility, 14,400x cap. Thunderkick lists the RTP as up to 96%, so check the casino's version.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
